inputs.label: Daytona USA arcade ROM sets (MAME 0.289)
inputs.help: Your own MAME 0.289 sets daytona.zip and model1io.zip. Leave them zipped.

steps.why: The app searches all storage for the ROM sets. The guide has the user allow this in the headset.

steps.text: Open Port0r: Daytona USA VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for All files access, allow it. The game copies the ROM sets in and starts; until then, a setup screen lists any missing files.

notes: port0r holds every Port0r game in one repository; tag selects Daytona USA VR. ^daytona-v does not match the daytona-android-v tags of the plain Android build. Granting the appop over adb is not yet tested on a Quest.
